events.description: Fairies are visiting Fort York Branch!  Join in the fun and see how many fairies you can find around the branch. Name each item that the fairy is resting upon, identify the circled letters and then decode the secret message from the fairies.  Scavenger hunts support letter awareness and spatial awareness, and of course, are fun for all! Receive a free prize for completing the scavenger hunt.

events.description: So long summer, hello new school year!  Stop by the library to find school related images hidden around the children's area. Find them all and win a fun prize! This activity is for children aged 4 to 12 years. *Please note that this a passive activity, not a program facilitated by staff. *

For pre-school and school-aged children and their caregivers. Live or automated closed captioning, sign language interpretation, intervenor services, or attendant services are available upon request. events.description: Come explore a different STEM-themed activity! STEM Saturday happens every other Saturday. Ages 6-12 Drop in until full. Space is limited.

events.description: Discover the science behind things that make you go…ewww! This program is a welcoming, hands-on activity that introduces you to the arts and builds community. Participants will receive all the supplies needed to design their own unique cookie while having fun connecting with others and expressing themselves.​ Food allergy notice : Please be aware that food will be used in this program. events.title: D&D for Teens: On-going Campaign
events.description: Play Dungeons and Dragons! Slay monsters and overcome challenges with a Librarian as your Dungeon Master. Ongoing Campaign. This is an in-person program for Teens . Space limited for players*, but watchers are welcome too. All supplies provided. Bring a 1st level character or pick a Pre-generated character. *Register in-person at the Youth Hub at 3:30PM. events.title: Artists in the Library: Origami Lotus Flowers
events.description: This is a six-part workshop series that creates a space for exploring belonging and not belonging through conversation and hands-on art-making. Guided by reflective questions, participants engage in practices such as origami with washi, drawing, dyeing, and writing, using the lotus as a shared symbol of transformation and resilience across cultures. events.title: Family Knit and Crochet Circle
events.description: Come craft with us! WS is hosting a once-a-month crafting circle where you can create and chat. Whether it's crochet, knitting, embroidery or sewing, connect with fellow craftspeople as you work on your project. All skill levels and all ages are welcome. *Note* We do supply yarn and crochet hooks/knitting needles for the program, if you need guidance on how to start learning we can help with that as well. events.title: Knitting Circle
events.description: Join Port Union Library's Knitting Circle. Chat and knit or crochet with a friendly group! You can also share your projects with others!  This is a drop in program but limited to a room capacity of 20 participants. Arrive early to secure your spot.  No registration required.

events.title: FRESH Movie Saturdays
events.description: This program helps people stay active, make friends, learn new skills, and have fun. Meet new folks, build connections, and tell us about programs and services you would like to see in the neighbourhood! Come join us every Saturday for screenings of your favourite movies. In addition to this, enjoy cuddles with a therapy dog! Therapy dog Goose visits Fort York Branch on alternate Saturdays from 11:00AM-12:00PM. We'll be showing the following films: Aug 22 - Beauty& The Beast(1991)

events.title: Saturday Chess Club
events.description: Join us on the 2nd floor every Saturday for a few games of chess in a welcoming environment. All ages and all levels are welcome. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian to participate. Any unsupervised individuals under 18 will not be able to participate in the program. This is a drop-in program.

events.title: Robotics Workshops for Youth
events.description: Join Upper Toronto Community Robotics for accessible, hands-on robotics and engineering workshops for youth! These programs will help you build foundational skills in engineering design, safety, CAD software, 3D modeling, and introductory robotics coding. This month's theme: Control Systems This program is for youth in grades 6-12. It is highly recommended to attend each session to build on your learning. Please register online.

events.title: Sunday Family Game Time

events.title: Bad Art Night
events.description: Forget perfection and embrace chaos in a glorious celebration of creativity, where the only rule is: make something terrible on purpose. Whether you're a seasoned artist or a total newbie who can't draw a straight line, this is your moment to shine. Drop in.

events.title: Youth Hub: Board Game Café
events.description: Join us in the Youth Hub every Tuesday to play board games with your friends! Ask us for our list of board games, and check our monthly calendar for Tournaments with prizes! All materials provided.  This program is part of Youth Hub service. Youth Hubs are a welcoming place for teens after school and in the summer, where helpful staff are always available. Free, nutritious snacks are offered daily. Drop by a branch with a Youth Hub or call the branch to find out more.

events.description: Drop-in every first Tuesday of the month to take part in video games and board games! Xbox One S games available. All games available on a first come, first serve basis.

events.description: Looking for a fun after-school activity? Join our Youth Chess Program to learn new skills, play matches, and connect with others!  This program is open to youth ages 7-17 years old. Facilitated by the University of Toronto Scarborough Chess Club. No registration required. Space is limited.

events.description: Join us in the Youth Hub every Thursday for a series of crafting activities like painting, clay sculpting, sewing and embroidery, resin art, jewelry making, perler beads, block printing, and more!
